notes: Dimensions taken from the GB locale of the Google Store tech-specs page, which publishes millimetres; the US locale of the SAME page publishes only inches rounded to 0.1 in ('6.1 in x 3 in x 0.4 in') and 9.1 oz, which would have been far less precise -- no conversion was performed. Display diagonals in INCHES come from the US locale ('6.3-inch (160 mm)', '8-inch (204 mm)'); the GB locale prints only the mm figure. Both pages were read via web.archive.org snapshots of the store.google.com URLs (US snapshot 2025-11-17, GB snapshot 2025-11-07) because store.google.com renders its spec table client-side and returned no spec text to curl or WebFetch; archived manufacturer pages count as primary. Google's footnote: 'Dimensions and weight vary by configuration and manufacturing process.' The device is discontinued/out of stock. Refresh: cover 60-120Hz, inner 1-120Hz (LTPO) -- maxima recorded. Hinge is 'Multi-alloy steel with an aerospace-grade high-strength aluminum alloy cover'; Google states no crease shape and no free-stop/hold-at-any-angle claim -> both null. The fingerprint sensor is side-mounted (power button) per Google's Fingerprint Unlock listing; position 'right' is the physical side, not separately stated on the spec page. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
